source: archive.org item NamesAndAttributesOfAllah (https://archive.org/details/NamesAndAttributesOfAllah), supplied by the Owner; posters carry the creative-motivations.com mark
transcribed: 2026-10-01, word for word from the poster images (printed typos kept and noted); 2 entries spot-checked by the Architect against the images
purpose: Owner decision 44 (pending design choice): the default description on each Asma ul Husna Name poster

entries.description: The Most High One Who is above all others. The One Who has risen over His throne and Who has encompassed the dominion. There is no one who is equal or even comparable to Him. He is free from any supposed evil, and from what heretics and disbelievers may say about Him. The One Who is Most High in all of His names and attributes, and the most Exalted and Supreme.  The One in Whom all the attributes of greatness, grandeur, magnificence, and beauty find perfection and fulfillment.
entries.notes: Heading printed without a hyphen ('Al A'laa'). Description has a double space after 'Supreme.' as printed.

entries.description: The One whose knowledge is neither acquired through learning, nor preceded by ignorance, nor followed by forgetfulness. He is aware of all things, past, present, and future. The One who has reached perfection in His Knowledge; Who Knows and has always Known. The One who is knowing of our deeds and nothing escapes him; His knowledge encompasses all of creation.
entries.notes: Lower-case 'him' in 'nothing escapes him' as printed.

entries.description: He is the One whose knowledge is comprehensive and extends to everything seen and unseen, apparent and hidden. Nothing whatsoever is hidden from Him and He knows what was in the past, what is in the present, and will be in the future.
entries.notes: DIFFERENT DESIGN from the creative-motivations series (no www.creative-motivations.com footer; parchment style). Heading and meaning on one line: 'Al-Aleem - The All-Knowing'. Arabic name is in a circular medallion, undiacritised. Carries a pasted Qur'an screenshot: verse 2:115 in Arabic (the word عَلِيمٌ boxed in green) with a 'Sahih International' translation: 'And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah . Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.' (with a space before the full stop after 'Allah', as printed). Ribbon at bottom: 'Mentioned 157 Times in the Qur'an'. The screenshot shows a '2:115' tag and 'to top' link (website UI).

entries.description: The One with full and perfect Knowledge, from which nothing is hidden. His Knowledge comprehends all things, the covert and overt, the small and the great, the concealed and revealed. He alone who holds the keys to the unseen: what is in the womb, what the future holds, when the rain will fall, where each creature will perish, and when the Hour will be established. The One from whom nothing is concealed on the earth or in the heavens.
entries.notes: Meaning printed on two lines: 'The Knower' / '(of the Seen & Unseen)'.

entries.meaning: The One Who Pardons Again & Again
entries.description: The One Who forgives and pardons. He is easy on His creation. He erases their sins, pardoning them and relinquishing their punishment, though they are deserving of punishment. The One Who has always been and will always be known for His pardoning.  The Pardoning.
entries.notes: Meaning printed on two lines: 'The One Who Pardons' / 'Again & Again'. Double space before 'The Pardoning.' as printed.

entries.description: The One who is Unique in His Attributes. His Uniqueness is an attribute of which no other may have any share and the quality of His attributes is incomparable and unequaled. He is Unique in every single aspect while His creation may seem unique in one aspect and common in others. The Singular.
entries.notes: Second paragraph (footnote, smaller type): '*This name (along with As-Samad) possesses a comprehensiveness in its indication of Allah and His attributes that is not found in any other name.'

entries.description: The One Whose existence is without end. The Last, there is nothing that will come after Him or exist after Him, for He will exist always and for eternity, while everything else will eventually perish.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Akheer' but the poster's heading reads 'Al-Aakhir'.

entries.description: The One Who is the Most Generous and none is like unto Him in His Generosity. He is the Most Generous towards His servants, showing understanding, patience and disregard towards their ignorance. This name is the superlative (highest) form of the word "Kareem" (generous, magnanimous, noble hearted) and may thus be understood as "The Most Noble Hearted, as well.
entries.notes: NOT the plain poster: a small product mock-up of the poster in a black picture frame on a blue rounded tile, with the caption '99 Names Wall Art Prints' below it. The poster text is very small (low resolution), so the description is a best reading; the closing quotation mark after 'Hearted' appears to be absent as printed. No creative-motivations footer visible.

entries.description: The One Who is high above His creation in His Power and Status. To Him belongs highness in all of its aspects: Highness of His Essence, Highness of His Attributes and Esteem, Highness of His Strength and Power. His attributes are high in degree, rank, and magnificence and are evident in their perfection. There is nothing like Him in all of His attributes. Everything is subservient to His will and authority. Nothing occurs or ceases to occur except by His leave. The High; The Sublime.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Aliyyu'; heading reads 'Al-'Aliyy'.

entries.description: The One who is Worshipped and shown Servitude. He is the One & Only Deity, the One Who is Worshipped and the One Who deserves to be worshipped by the whole of His creation, due to the Perfect Godly Attributes that He is described with. The One who is absolutely independent upon who all depend. He does not beget, nor was He begotten and there is none comparable to Him. This is Allah’s Personal Name. This Name only belongs to Allah, no one else can have it besides Him.
entries.notes: Meaning line is printed inside curly braces: '{The Grand Name}'. File name says 'The Proper Name' but poster says 'The Grand Name'. Uses a typographic apostrophe in 'Allah’s'.

entries.description: The One Whose existence is without a beginning. The First, there is nothing that came before Him. He has always existed and nothing preceded Him in existence. Everything else has been created and gone from a state of non-existence to existence, except Allah.

The One Who is greater, more exalted and magnificent than anything. The Mighty One in His power, gravity and eminence. Everything is subject to His might and power, and nothing is higher, greater or superior to Him. He possesses all of the qualities of Magnification, and no creature can praise Him to the degree that He truly deserves, rather He is as He has praised Himself, and He is above the praise of His creatures.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Azeem'; heading reads 'Al-'Adheem'. Meaning printed on two lines: 'The Tremendous One,' / 'The Magnificent'.

entries.description: The One who is distinguished, respected, and there is none like Him. He is invincible, unbeatable and cannot be overwhelmed. He is Mighty and is severe in His vengeance upon those from whom He seeks revenge. None can prevent Him from fulfilling what He wills.

The One who brings the creation out of non-existence into existence; Who creates something from nothing; Who invents and innovates with no prior model, and who gives His creation distinct characteristics which distinguishes them from one another. The Creator of the universe and all that it contains.
entries.notes: Heading ends with an apostrophe: 'Al-Baari''. Meaning on two lines: 'The Originator,' / 'The Inventor'. 'non-existence' is hyphenated across a line break and kept as one hyphenated word.

entries.description: The One who is bountiful and giving towards His creatures. He gives and extends provisions, sustenance and wealth freely and with great generosity. He provides for the needs of His creation, bestowing upon them bounties. The One who gives life to the hearts, whose glory and abundance expand the hearts of His creation. The One who releases the souls, allowing them to live. The Extremely Generous.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Extender,' / 'The Munificent'.

entries.description: The One Who is nearer than anything in existence, nothing can be closer to anything than Him. He is near us through His knowledge, hearing, and sight and He is knowing of all things. The Inward, Who knows the innermost matters, all that is secret and hidden, down to the smallest matters. The One Who us keenly discerning.
entries.notes: Typo as printed: 'The One Who us keenly discerning' (presumably 'is'); kept verbatim.

entries.description: The One Who is Most Kind, Courteous & Generous. Whose generosity is expansive. He is gentle with His servants and does not want hardship for them. He pardons our many sins & wrongdoings and does not take us to account for all of our crimes. He rewards our good deeds with ten more like it, while He does not recompense a sin with more, and He does not hold our desire to sin against us.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Generous' / '& Most Courteous'. No www.creative-motivations.com footer on this one; instead a diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com'.

entries.description: The One who has insight into all things and who perceives every detail, every state of existence, and every circumstance. He is aware of everything that takes place in the universe, even down to the most minuscule, seemingly invisible action, and He recompenses His servants accordingly by His wisdom and ultimate justice. The All-Perceiving, The All-Comprehending.
entries.notes: 'All-Perceiving' is split across a line break at its hyphen; joined as one hyphenated word.

entries.description: The One Who is above everything else, He is the Most High, above all things, and there is nothing higher than Him. The One Who is the Uppermost by virtue of His Wisdom, power of creation, actions and all the blessings which He bestows. His existence is obvious by proofs. The Manifest. The Outward. The Triumphant.

entries.meaning: The Judge & Opener (Who Distinguishes Truth from Falsehood)
entries.description: The Most trustworthy and wise Judge, who will judge between His servants on the Day of Resurrection with perfect justice. The One who opens all the doors of mercy, profit, and sustenance to His slaves, and provides them the means of attaining both the good in this life and the Hereafter. He opens the eyes and hearts (of those who are sincere and truthful) to the truth, removes their difficulties, gives victory, and opens the doors of knowledge and understanding so that we may know Him, love Him and repent to Him. The Opener and Giver of Knowledge and the ultimate Judge.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Judge & Opener' / '(Who Distinguishes Truth from Falsehood)'.

entries.description: The One Who is completely and absolutely free from all wants and deficiencies. He is not in need of His creation or any actions of His creation. Rather, we are completely in need of Him. If all of creation, from the first to the last, were to rise up in one place and make a request of Him, and He granted their requests, it would not decrease what He has any more than a needle decreases the sea if dipped into it. To Him belong the dominions of the heaven and the earth and He has no partner in His dominion.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Ganiyyu'; heading reads 'Al-Ghaniyy'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Rich,' / 'The Self-Sufficient'.

entries.description: The One forgives those who turn in sincere repentance to Him. The One who continues to forgive and pardon us, again and again, regardless of how many times we sin. He never tires of forgiving us and the quantity of His forgiveness is perpetually abundant.
entries.notes: 'The One forgives' as printed (no 'who').

entries.description: The One who covers our sins, fully aware of what they are, and protects us from the consequences of them by granting His forgiveness. The One whose forgiveness encompasses every sin, no matter the enormity, when the sinner sincerely repents. The quality of His forgiveness is vast and all-encompassing.

The One who is ever-mindful and constantly on guard. He guards and preserves all of creation from perishing and His knowledge encompasses all that He has brought into existence. The One who accounts the actions of His servants and their rewards and protects His Awliyaa (close friends) from falling into sins and destructive matters. The Preserver.

The One Who is Extremely Gracious and responsive to His creation, and tends to their needs. The One Who graciously responds to our deepest need, i.e. His guidance; guiding the people to His sincere worship. The One who is Most Gracious and Knowledgeable. The Ever Gracious.

The most just Judge. The One who judges between His servants in this life and the Hereafter with truth, wisdom, fairness, complete justice and immense mercy. He will not oppress anyone to the extent of an atoms weight, and none will be made to carry the encumbrance of another. No servant will be recompensed in a way that is greater that the magnitude of his or her sin, rather, each servant will be given only what he or she deserves. The Arbitrator, The Giver of Justice.
entries.notes: Printed as-is: 'an atoms weight' (no apostrophe) and 'greater that the magnitude' (presumably 'than').

entries.description: The One whose Wisdom encompasses all things and who is Wise in His sayings and actions. He is wise in His creation and covenants and nothing is created without purpose and perfection. He places things into their proper places. And due to His wisdom, He is just and His commands, laws and judgments are just. The Most Judicious.

The One Who is worthy of All Praise. He deserves to be praised in all of His deeds, sayings, laws commands and prohibitions. He possesses the most perfect of attributes and best and most complete actions, for His actions are based upon Grace and Justice. He Who has created, provided, and bestowed His favors upon His creation and deserves to be praised at all times.
entries.notes: 'laws commands' printed without a comma between them.

entries.description: The One who is the only true god. He truly exists and is truly divine, and all else besides Him is falsehood. He is the most truthful; His existence is true; His promise, action and speech are true; the meeting with Him is true; His Messengers are the truth; the afterlife is the truth; and the Day of Judgment is the truth. The One through whom all righteousness, justice, and truth are revealed.
entries.notes: Lower-case 'god' in 'the only true god' as printed.

entries.description: The One Who is All-Knowing of His servants and sufficient for those who put their trust in Him. He takes care of His slaves in both worldly and spiritual matters and is the Creator of the means which produce sufficiency. The One who will take account of all people's deeds and who will reward or punish them in accordance to His Wisdom and His Knowledge of the smallest and greatest of their deeds. The swiftest in taking account.
entries.notes: Low-resolution copy (about 330px wide); text small but legible, read carefully. Meaning on two lines: 'The All-Sufficient,' / 'The Reckoner'.

entries.description: The Ever-Living One Who has no beginning and no end. He lives and does not die. He gives life to everything else in disposing of all matters and apportioning of all things. The One Who has perfect life, existing in and of Himself, not dependent upon anyone else. His life is far removed from resembling the imperfect life of His creatures.
entries.notes: Meaning heading 'The Ever Living' has no hyphen, while the description writes 'Ever-Living'.

entries.meaning: The One Who Alone Deserves to Be Worshipped
entries.description: The Only deity Who deserves to be adored and worshipped. The One Who is to be singled out in His divinity. He has no partners or associates. The One Who is shown dedication to; the One Who everyone is humble to; the One Who is worshipped. He is the only true God.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The One Who Alone' / 'Deserves to Be Worshipped'. Arabic shows kasra under the hamza and damma on the final haa; no mark is visible on the lam (no fatha or dagger alif seen).

entries.description: The One Who implements His will; The One Who compels His creation (toward good). The Greatest One Who is Exalted, high above His creation. The One Who reforms and amends the affairs of His creation. Where there is a deficiency, He completes it. Where a heart is broken, He repairs it.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Compellor' / '& Restorer' (spelling 'Compellor' as printed). No www.creative-motivations.com footer; diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com' instead.

entries.description: The One Who is beautiful and loves beauty. He is beautiful in His essence, His names, His attributes, and His actions. Suffice it is that if He would uncover the veil of His face, the brightness and magnificence of His beauty would burn His creation so far as it reaches. He has adorned the universe with great beauty and splendor and loves beauty (both inward and outward) in His creation.

The One Who is Most Magnanimous and His Magnanimity encompasses all of creation with bounty and kindness, as decreed by His wisdom. He does not turn away anyone who asks, even if he is from a kaafir nation, however, the believers enjoy the greater part of His mercy and giving. The One Who is very generous, giving, benevolent and noble and is above seeking revenge or being resentful, rather, He is generous in His forgiveness, unselfish and gracious. The Munificent.
entries.notes: Has a smaller third heading line under the meaning: 'The One Who Grants Generously'.

entries.description: He is the Magnificent, the Sublime and the Most Great in His Being, attributes and actions, and there is nothing greater than Him.
entries.notes: DIFFERENT DESIGN from the creative-motivations series (parchment style, no www.creative-motivations.com footer). Heading line reads 'Al-Kabeer  -  The  Greatest'. Arabic name in a circular medallion, undiacritised. Pasted Qur'an screenshot of verse 13:9 (Arabic, ending ﴿٩﴾) with 'Sahih International' translation: '[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.' In THIS file the words الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ in the verse are boxed in green (hence 'Al-Mutawaal' in the file name; the poster itself does not print 'Al-Mutawaal' as a heading). Ribbon: 'Mentioned 6 Times in the Qur'an'. Otherwise the same poster as '(Kabeer) Al-Kabeer.png'.

entries.description: He is the Magnificent, the Sublime and the Most Great in His Being, attributes and actions, and there is nothing greater than Him.
entries.notes: DIFFERENT DESIGN (parchment style, no creative-motivations footer). Near-duplicate of '(Kabeer) Al-Kabeer Al-Mutawaal.jpg': same heading, description, verse 13:9 screenshot with the same Sahih International translation '[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.', and ribbon 'Mentioned 6 Times in the Qur'an' — but WITHOUT the green box around the words in the verse. Arabic in medallion is undiacritised.

entries.description: The One who is noble, generous and gracious to all that is in existence. The Most Generous who abundantly gives from His bounty which never ends. He gives blessings to His creation, even if they do not worship Him. His generosity, greatness and graciousness do not depend upon anyone and are limitless. The One who, when He gives, gives more than what was hoped for. The Abundant in Good.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Bountiful,' / 'The Generous'.

entries.description: The One who creates something from nothing and determines and creates according to the proper measure and proportion of each thing. The One who plans and determines how, when and where to create. The One whose works are perfectly suited, appropriate, fitting and proper.

The One whose knowledge encompasses all of the outward and hidden matters, the open and secret, all those things that must necessarily occur, are impossible to occur, and can possibly occur, of the past, present, and future affairs of the whole of creation. He knows the internal and external qualities of things and there is absolutely nothing that is hidden from Him.

entries.meaning: The Creator Who Creates Again & Again
entries.description: The One Who creates everything in the creation and is not weakened or affected by this. He only commands a thing once, 'Be!', and it is. He creates continuously, not after the similitude of anything pre-existing, but brings into a state of existence from a state of non-existence according to a pre-determination required by His wisdom. He creates in perfection and administers the creation of all of His creatures.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Khallaq'; heading reads 'Al-Khallaaq'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Creator Who Creates' / 'Again & Again'. 'pre-determination' breaks across lines at its hyphen ('pre-' / 'determination'); kept hyphenated, matching 'pre-existing' on the same poster.

entries.description: The One who is knowledgeable of the most subtle and minuscule matters that will lead to His slaves' well-being. He is Well-Aware of the situations of His servants, and nothing is hidden from Him of thoughts, hopes and secrets. He knows how to guide them to what will benefit them, and He does so with kindness, love and gentleness.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Most Subtle,' / 'The Kind'.

entries.description: The One Who is the owner of majesty and honor. The One Who is the owner of all things, and all are under His command. He is the majestic Sovereign Who created everything and controls all destiny. The One Who directs all of the affairs to do with creation, command, and recompense. To Him belongs the whole of creation, all of it is subservient, owned by, and in continuous need of Him. The Omnipotent King. The Sovereign.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Maaleek'; heading reads 'Al-Maleek'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Omnipotent' / 'Sovereign'.

entries.description: The Owner, Who possesses, and the King, Who has complete authority and commands what He possesses. The One to Whom the commanding and forbidding belong. The King, The Sovereign Lord, The One with the Complete Dominion.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Maalik'; heading reads 'Al-Malik'. Meaning on two lines: 'The King & Owner' / 'of Dominion'. No www.creative-motivations.com footer; diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com' instead.

entries.description: The One Who is very Bountiful. He most graciously bestows His favors, provisions, and blessings upon His creation, even though they may be ungrateful. The Benefactor, the Generous One Who is kind and Who gives generously from His bounty. His generosity is overwhelming with compassion and kindness.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Mannan'; heading reads 'Al-Mannaan'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Beneficent Bestower' / 'of Bounties'. Second paragraph (footnote, smaller type): '*This is Allah's most sublime name, when called upon by it, He responds, and when besought by it, He bestows.'

entries.description: The One Who is firm and strong. He is not in need of anything; He is not in need of His creation. Rather, His creation is completely in need of Him. The One Who is most strong in His power and ability, neither weariness nor toil ever touches Him; His strength knows no bounds and He is able to do all things. The Most Strong.
entries.notes: Image is cropped: the outer frame and the footer are cut off (no website line visible); the text itself appears complete.

entries.meaning: The One Who Gives Emaan & Security
entries.description: The One who has and gives Emaan (affirmation of faith) and the One who gives peace and security from fear. He provides serenity to the hearts of the Believers. He affirms the truthfulness of His Messengers & Prophets and always fulfills His promises. The Guardian of Faith.
entries.notes: File name misspells it 'Al-Mu'mim'; heading reads 'Al-Mu'min'. Meaning on two lines: 'The One Who Gives' / 'Emaan & Security'.

entries.description: The One Who gives wealth & knowledge. He is generous and bountiful. He provides for His servants their needs. The giver of security, peace and sustenance. He is the most magnanimous giver. There is none who can prevent what He gives and none who can give what He prevents. Every thing that can bring goodness or benefit is sought and desired from Him. He is the One Who gives to whomsoever He Wills and prevents from Whosoever He Wills, all of this in accordance to His Wisdom and Mercy.
entries.notes: 'Every thing' (two words) and capitalised 'Whosoever' as printed.

entries.description: The One Who defers and holds back whomsoever He wills, and there is wisdom and goodness in whatever He does, even though the purpose of that wisdom and goodness may be hidden from us. The One who delays or slows whatever He wills. He postpones things from their expected times because in His wisdom He knows the consequences of the delay.  The Deferrer. The One Who Delays.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Muakkhir'; heading reads 'Al-Mu'akhkhir'. Meaning on two lines: 'The One Who' / 'Puts Back'. Double space before 'The Deferrer.' as printed.

entries.description: The One Who is the Clear & Manifest Truth. He is evident in His essence and, fulfilling His promise, will make everything evident to us on the Day of Judgment, including the true magnitude of our actions, good and bad. The One Who has made clear to His creation the path to right guidance, what will benefit them in their worldly lives and the hereafter, and the path of misguidance, the evil deeds that will incur His wrath. The Manifest. The Evident.

The One Who is aware of everything that is hidden and concealed, and Whose knowledge encompasses all things. He witnesses the sayings and deeds of His creation, knows what is harmful and beneficial, and protects and watches over us.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Muhayimin'; heading reads 'Al-Muhaymin'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Protector' / '& Overseer'. Footer slightly cut at the bottom edge.

entries.description: The One Who encompasses everything in His mercy, knowledge, ability, hearing, and seeing. He has knowledge of everything, and surrounds and thoroughly comprehends (all things). The One Who has power and dominance over everything, and encompasses or surrounds it, such that nothing can escape from Him or elude Him.

entries.meaning: The One Who Does Perfect Good
entries.description: The One Who constantly does that which is Good with Perfection. He showers the good and the bad, the believing and unbelieving, of His creation with Ihsan (goodness and favors). The One Who is benevolent, generous, bountiful, kind and compassionate. He has shown mankind the two ways of good and evil, and He gives them the ability to enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil. The Charitable. The One Who Acts in a Good & Fine Manner.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The One Who Does' / 'Perfect Good'. 'Ihsan' is printed in italics.

entries.description: The One who responds to the prayers of His servants (when they are patient and do not give up hope.) He is the One who answers, in a general sense, those who supplicate to Him, whoever they may be, wherever they may be, and whatever condition they may be in. And answers, in a specific sense, those who love Him, and imitate and follow His Shari'ah. Also, the One who responds to the prayers of those in dire need, and the One who inspires us to ask. The Answerer.
entries.notes: Full stop inside the bracket '(... give up hope.)' as printed.

entries.description: The One who gives precedence, He brings forward and favors whomsoever He wills, giving some a higher status than others in accordance with His wisdom. The One Who hastens or speeds, sending down events and expediting them as He wills. The Expediter. The One Who Brings Forward.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Muqaddimu'; heading reads 'Al-Muqaddim'. Meaning on two lines: 'The One Who Gives' / 'Precedence'.

entries.description: The One Who provides everything that is in existence with what would strengthen and sustain it; Who provides their nourishment, whether He brings it to them or leads them to it, and provides it in due proportion and time, in accordance to His Wisdom and Praise. The Sustainer and Supporter, the One Who protects and witnesses over His creation. The Master Who is capable of all things.
entries.notes: VERY low-resolution copy (236 x 312 px); description text is tiny and is a best reading — should be checked against a better copy. Meaning on two lines in different sizes: 'The All-Powerful' (small) / 'Maintainer' (large).

entries.description: The Master Who is capable of anything He wishes, without weakness, without fatigue. He is All-Capable and All-Powerful. The One Who created everything, and controls the destinies of everyone. He can grant the supplications of His servants and nothing stands to oppose or resist Him. The Perfect in Ability. The One with perfect power from Whom nothing is withheld.

The One who brings into existence anything that  He wills in the shape and form He decides.  He has given everything in creation its own distinct design in accordance to His wisdom and He is continuously doing so. He simply says, "be" and it is, in the manner and form that He desires. The Designer. The Giver of Forms.
entries.notes: Double spaces as printed after 'that' and after 'decides.'. Lower-case "be" in quotation marks as printed.

entries.description: The One Who is above His creation in irresistible Power and Might. The One Who is Most High; an absolute Highness in every sense. He is free from all partners and defects in His sublimity, there is nothing similar unto Him, the attributes of creation cannot compare to Him, and He holds dominance and power over all. He is the One, the Irresistible, who compels all of the creation with His Might and Exaltedness. Whatever He wills will be and none can resist Him in that. The Most High, The Sublime.

The One who is supremely great. The One who is greater than all of creation and who manifests His greatness in all things and in all ways. The One who has rights, privileges and attributes which no other may possess. He is free from any evil, defect or deficiency. The One who is clear from the attributes of His creatures and from resembling them. The Supreme.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Superior,' / 'The Majestic'.

entries.description: The One who guides and protects the believers from harm, loves them, and shows them mercy. He is the Helper and Supporter who backs and strengthens the believers. The One who is entrusted in neither humiliating His friends nor in ruining them; The One who aids them against their enemies.
entries.notes: Low-resolution copy (about 330px wide); text small but legible.

entries.description: The One Who withholds the provisions, wealth, and sustenance, and seizes the souls of His creation (causing them to die), all in compliance with His wisdom and mercy. He decides when to withhold something or to make it scarce, either physically or spiritually. He withholds and restricts when it is good for us and none can withhold provisions except Him.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Withholder,' / 'The Restrictor'.

entries.description: The One Who is capable of doing anything He wills. The One Who possesses complete power and ability and perfectly does what He wills according to what His perfect wisdom requires. He is able to do all things and neither weakness, nor impotence or languor overtakes Him. The Able.

The One Who has made everything subdued and submissive. He has subdued all of His creatures; everything in the upper and lower worlds is subservient to His will and authority, including tyrants who will be humbled before Him. All creatures are in need of Him and they have no control of good or harm upon themselves. The One Who can prevent His servants from achieving their desires, as well as help and sustain them. The Irresistible, Over-Powering One.

The One Who has complete and perfect power and ability by which He brought everything into existence and by which arranges all affairs. The Omnipotent, the All-Powerful, the Master of all things. The One Who, when He will a thing to be, He merely says, "Be!" and it is. Every created being's capabilities are based entirely upon the whatever strength and ability Allah gives to it.
entries.notes: As printed: 'by which arranges all affairs', 'when He will a thing to be', 'upon the whatever strength'.

entries.description: The One who dominates everything in His kingdom. The One before whom the whole of creation has humbled itself, and submitted, whether willingly or unwillingly,  before His Grandeur, power and Perfect Strength. He has power and control over all things and nothing occurs except what He allows.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The All-Prevailing,' / 'The Subduer'. Double space after 'unwillingly,' as printed.

entries.description: The Strong One Who is capable of doing what He wills. There is nothing capable of defeating Him or of thwarting His decree. The One to Whom belongs all Might; the might of power, dominance and superiority. All creatures are subdued by Him, yielding and submitting to His Greatness. None can overcome Him and stand against His Decree; it is carried out with perfection and full effect in accordance with His Knowledge and Wisdom.
entries.notes: Arabic: the final yaa appears to carry only a damma, with no shadda visible (usual spelling is القَوِيُّ); transcribed as seen.

entries.description: The One Who has perfect power, existing in and of Himself and not dependent upon anyone else. The One who is Self-Subsisting, and by Whom all things subsist. The Caretaker who manages and sustains, protects, and preserves His creation, and runs all affairs in accordance with His knowledge, wisdom, and justice.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Qayyuum'; heading reads 'Al-Qayyoom'. Smaller third heading line under the meaning: 'Upon Whom Everything Depends'.

entries.description: The One Who is Very Pure, Absolutely Pure, He is far above anything that does not befit Him (i.e. imperfection, error, fault shortcoming and everything that is derogatory.) The Holy, the Most Sacred.
entries.notes: 'fault shortcoming' printed without a comma. No www.creative-motivations.com footer; diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com' instead.

entries.description: The One with immense mercy, kindness and compassion; Who cares about everything and gives mercy to anything or anyone He chooses. Due to His kindness, He warns the creation against His punishment and prefers guidance and goodness for them. The One Whose kindness is so immense that He provides provisions, safety and good health even to those who disobey and lie against Him.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Compassionate' / '& Kind'. Second paragraph (footnote): '*This form is more intensive than Ar-Raheem.' with 'intensive' in italics.

entries.description: The Master who has no equal in His Sovereignty, Predominance, and Highness. The One who Provides, Sustains, Owns, Cherishes, and Organizes all that is in existence. He nurtures and sustains all of His servants through regulating the affairs and granting all types of favors and blessings; He gives all things the power to grow, to move, to change, and to Him belongs the creation and commandment.
entries.notes: Footer slightly cut at the bottom edge.

entries.description: The One Who is kind, compassionate and gentle. He showers His servants with mercy and forgiveness. He loves gentleness and kindness in all matters, and He gives, as a result of it, what He does not give for harshness. The One Who embodies with perfection the greatest gentleness and benevolence.

The One who has plenty of mercy especially for the believers. The Most Compassionate, meaning His mercy and compassion, in this respect, applies specifically to the believers particularly in the next life. A mercy not afforded to the disbelievers.
entries.notes: Description is printed as TWO paragraphs: 'The One who has plenty of mercy especially for the believers.' / 'The Most Compassionate, ... disbelievers.' — joined here with a single space.

entries.description: The One Who has plenty of mercy for the believers and the disbelievers in this life. The All Compassionate, meaning His mercy and compassion, in this respect, applies to all of His creation.
entries.notes: Arabic carries a dagger (superscript) alif over the meem. No www.creative-motivations.com footer; diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com' instead.

entries.description: The One who closely watches over His creation. He hears, sees, and knows everything and nothing escapes Him. He sees what is hidden in the hearts and minds, what is done in secret and in the open. The One who charges every soul with what it has earned. The ever-vigilant witness. The Observer.

The One who creates all means of nourishment and subsistence. He is the One who provides everything that is needed (rizq) for everyone, as a means of support and growth for the body, the mind, the heart, and the spiritual life. He gives to everyone, regardless of whether they worship Him, and He apportions these provisions in a manner that befits His wisdom and mercy. The Bestower of Sustenance.
entries.notes: File name says 'Ar-Razzaq'; heading reads 'Ar-Razzaaq'.

entries.description: The One Who is Free from all imperfections and deficiencies. He keeps His creation free from injustice from Him. He provides safety, security, and a sense of peace and tranquility to those who purify themselves and submit.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Perfection &' / 'Giver of Peace'. No www.creative-motivations.com footer; diagonal background watermark 'CREATIVE MOTIVATIONS™' / 'www.creative-motivations.com' instead.

entries.description: The One whose hearing and attention comprehends everything. He hears every sound and voice in all their different languages and various needs. He listens to the speech of His creatures: their exchanges, secrets, whispers and conversations, and pays attention to every supplication and invocation. The One who, if the entire universe were to speak at once, He would distinguish each and everyone of their individual sounds.
entries.notes: Heading ends with an apostrophe: 'As-Samee''. Meaning on two lines: 'The All-Hearing,' / 'The Ever-Listening'.

entries.description: The One Who is the Master; Sovereign of the Universe. All of creation is enslaved to Him. The One Who is needed in an absolute sense. No created being is independent of Him. If He did not create them, they would not exist, and if He did not sustain them after creating them, they would not remain. If He did not help them with all that they are faced with, they would have no help besides Him. The One Whom the entire creation turns to to satisfy their needs. The Master of everything and everyone.
entries.notes: 'turns to to satisfy' (double 'to') as printed.

entries.description: The One Who cures people of their illnesses and ailments. He cures physical diseases of the body and psychological diseases of the mind, as well as spiritual diseases of the heart and soul. The One Who renders the cause of the means effective or nullifies their effects. He has sent down a cure for every disease. The Healer.

The One who recognizes the obedience and worship of His believing servants by rewarding them. He appreciates those who appreciate Him; recognizes and rewards those who give thanks to Him; and remembers those who remember Him. Whoever seeks to get close to Him by doing any righteous action, He draws close to them by a greater degree. The One whose reward for the small deed is immense, and He knows the sufficiency of His rewards.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Recognizer &' / 'Rewarder of Good'.

entries.description: The One who is Honest and Trustworthy in His testimony. He is Aware of everything. He hears every voice - the loud and the quiet; sees everything in existence - the significant and the insignificant. The One who will testify against His servants on the Day of Resurrection and will be the Witness for the oppressed who have no other witness or supporter, thus restoring their rights and avenging them.
entries.notes: Spaced hyphens ' - ' used as dashes, as printed.

entries.description: The One who rewards the believing servants for their good deeds, giving them far more than they deserve. The One who recognizes and appreciates all good, no matter how minute or intangible, even the good thought that is never carried out, and even the good of the sinner and the disbeliever.

The One Who is above all that is not befitting to Him and He is above all the shortcomings and (imperfect) qualities which are inherent in His creation. He is far removed from every evil,  imperfection, shortcoming, partner, companion, offspring and everything that is not fitting for Divinity. The All Perfect. There is nothing like unto Him.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Subbuhu'; heading reads 'As-Subooh'. Double space after 'evil,' as printed.

entries.description: The One who is continuously turning [in forgiveness] to those who turn to Him [in repentance] and the One who forgives the sins of the penitent. The One who grants us the ability to repent, directs our hearts towards Him, then accepts our [sincere] repentance and forgives our errors. The only One whose forgiveness and mercy know no bounds.
entries.notes: Meaning on two lines: 'The Accepting of' / 'Repentance'.

entries.description: The One Who is Good, Pure, far removed from every imperfection and deficiency. He has only exceptional qualities; qualities of perfection. He is the most excellent, superior, bountiful, and virtuous. The One Who only accepts that which is good and pure from the sayings and actions of His servants. The Good.

The One who is Unique in His Essence and unrivaled, unparalleled and unmatched in His Perfection. He has no partner, no equal and no rival and there is absolutely nothing like unto Him. The One and Only God, Lord of all of Creation, who requires no second or partner and is alone in His divinity. The only one worthy of worship, whose decree is to be followed and observed and of whom nothing can share in the obedience and worship that is due to Him.
entries.notes: VERY low-resolution copy (236 x 318 px); description text is tiny and is a best reading — should be checked against a better copy.

entries.description: The One Who inherits everything, the earth and all that is upon it, because all created life shall cease, leaving only Him, the Creator. Indeed, to Him all things shall return.

The One Who encompasses all of His creation with satisfaction and generosity. His favor is immense and He grants mercy to all things. He accommodates the requests of His creation and does not burden them or hold them responsible for what is beyond their capabilities. His knowledge and mercy encompasses everything. The Vast.
entries.notes: Heading ends with an apostrophe: 'Al-Waasi''. Same meaning line ('The All-Encompassing') as the Al-Muheet poster.

entries.description: The One Who loves whoever turns to Him in repentance from his or her sins. The One who loves His prophets and messengers, His allies and friends (awliyaa') and expresses it through His forgiveness. He is Full of Love towards the believers; He praises them and is Benevolent towards them. He gives them signs of His love for them and causes others to love them as well.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Wadud'; heading reads 'Al-Wadood'. Image is cropped at the bottom: the website footer is cut off (only the tops of its letters show).

entries.meaning: The Giver of Gifts, The Bestower
entries.description: The One who continually bestows gifts, favors, mercy and success upon all of creation. The One who gives freely and endlessly without expectation of any return. He gives without our earning it/working for it and His gifts are unmatchable. The Bestower who gives whatever He wills to whomsoever He wills.
entries.notes: File name says 'Al-Wahhab'; heading reads 'Al-Wahhaab'. Meaning on two lines: 'The Giver of Gifts,' / 'The Bestower'.

entries.description: The One who guides the believers, protects them from harm, and guards them. He is the trustee over His creatures and is the Disposer of affairs for everything in existence. The One who gives provision and protection and controls all that occurs. The Ultimate Trustee.

The One, the Only, the Single. He has no partners. He is the only deity worthy of worship and only creator and Lord of the universe. He has no equal in His essence, names, attributes and actions. The One Who loves everything odd in number which He has ordained. He is One and Unique and loves to be singled out as the One True God Who exclusively deserves to be worshipped.
entries.notes: Arabic carries no final vowel mark on the raa (kasra under waw, sukun on taa only).
